entries.v06_rule: Normal cards are acquired from persistent region-bound public racks.
entries.v07_rule: Normal and commodity cards share one global partially visible sushi track.
entries.cutover_gate: Unified track is the sole normal-card acquisition writer and all viewers receive only authorized local segments.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete region-rack normal-card purchase actions, refresh ownership, and target-oracle assertions.

entries.v06_rule: Commodity track and region normal-card supply are separate systems.
entries.v07_rule: One sequence mixes normal_card and commodity_card with one cadence and color distribution.
entries.cutover_gate: One owner emits typed entries for both card kinds with deterministic replay.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete the independent commodity-only sequence writer after Save migration.

entries.v06_rule: Live monsters in or adjacent to a source region increase ordinary-card cash price.
entries.v07_rule: Monster position and range do not automatically modify ordinary-card price.
entries.cutover_gate: Core quotes match authored base and explicit modifier rules for all viewers.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete monster proximity price formulas and their stale tests.

entries.v06_rule: Source-region sunlight controls ordinary-card purchase eligibility.
entries.v07_rule: Sunlight never controls card supply, price, or purchase; it multiplies declared facility work rates by 2.0 sunlit and 1.0 dark.
entries.cutover_gate: Core solar state drives only allowlisted work-rate channels and all card legality is solar-independent.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete sunlight card-eligibility and card-price branches.

entries.v06_rule: Historical V0.7 planning let GDP drive long-horizon commodity color supply; V0.6 track visibility also depends on GDP rank.
entries.v07_rule: Each cycle resets to uniform color shares; GDP affects neither track color nor card-kind distribution.
entries.cutover_gate: Deterministic 3/4/6/8-player simulations prove uniform reset and non-compounding normalized stances.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete GDP supply and GDP-rank track-visibility calculations.

entries.v06_rule: Colored mana/asset state can recover on continuous world time.
entries.v07_rule: Six-color assets top up once after batch resolution from the GDP snapshot frozen at submission lock.
entries.cutover_gate: Frozen-snapshot top-up, carry, cap, remainder, and replay pass exact deterministic vectors.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete continuous recovery writers and timers.

entries.v06_rule: Legacy mana guidance permits a high shared or per-color ceiling such as 100.
entries.v07_rule: Each of six color assets has an independent cap of 6.
entries.cutover_gate: All six pools enforce cap 6 independently and overflow is discarded exactly once.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete cap-100 constants, UI scales, and stale fixtures.

entries.v06_rule: Internal and historical player text uses mana terminology.
entries.v07_rule: The player-facing term is six-color assets; Mana, mana points, and their Chinese equivalents are retired.
entries.cutover_gate: V0.7 schemas and player projections use stable six-color asset IDs and approved localized messages.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Retire V0.7 player-facing mana aliases; keep explicit V0.6 migration readers only where versioned.

entries.v06_rule: A purchased ordinary card enters the normal hand.
entries.v07_rule: A purchased normal card enters personal discard and is not immediately usable.
entries.cutover_gate: Purchase receipts attest discard destination and hand count never changes directly from purchase.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete purchase-to-hand mutation and compatibility writes.

entries.v06_rule: The current runtime has no complete personal normal-card draw/discard lifecycle.
entries.v07_rule: Every player owns draw, hand, escrow, resolution, discard, and authoritative reshuffle state.
entries.cutover_gate: Per-player deck lifecycle and isolated RNG streams replay exactly across Save/restore.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete V0.6 disappearance and non-deck card lifecycle assumptions.

entries.v06_rule: The current runtime does not use the constitutional twelve-card personal starter DBG.
entries.v07_rule: Each player starts with one L1 factory and one L1 market in each color, shuffles, and draws five without pattern correction.
entries.cutover_gate: Twelve stable card IDs and a seeded five/seven split pass for every player.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete alternate opening normal-card grants and pattern-forcing setup.

entries.v06_rule: Some full-hand paths can automatically merge matching cards.
entries.v07_rule: Normal merge is an explicit player choice between equal-level, same-family unlocked hand cards.
entries.cutover_gate: Human and AI submit the same typed merge intent and Core produces a new-instance receipt.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete auto-merge triggers and name-based family inference.

entries.v06_rule: Commodity cards may auto-merge through equal-rank or linear paths and retain level IV.
entries.v07_rule: Commodity merge is manual: L1+L1 to L2 and L2+L1 to L3; maximum level is L3.
entries.cutover_gate: Only stable same-commodity IDs merge through the two legal edges with authoritative receipts.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete auto-merge and level-IV commodity schemas, UI, and tests.

entries.v06_rule: Normal and commodity cards share a five-card runtime capacity.
entries.v07_rule: Normal hand and commodity inventory have independent limits of five each.
entries.cutover_gate: Core, AI, player projection, and Save carry two counts and two limits without a mixed-hand authority.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete shared-capacity writers and generic hand_limit aliases.

entries.v06_rule: Card resolution may open a timed Counter Window and accept counter play.
entries.v07_rule: Resolution accepts no new gameplay or target input; defenses are precommitted or automatic.
entries.cutover_gate: All defensive semantics resolve from locked state and resolution input count remains zero.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete Counter Window, counter stack, timers, AI policies, UI, and save fields.

entries.v06_rule: A player queue or bid-derived group can resolve contiguously and expose ordering clues.
entries.v07_rule: Global resolution rotates by local action index through frozen hidden lead order and hides actor identity.
entries.cutover_gate: Deterministic queue vectors preserve local order and expose no actor identity or skip cue.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete contiguous-group and bid-order production resolution paths.

entries.v06_rule: Some cards select or revise targets during temporary resolution decisions.
entries.v07_rule: Every active action binds complete targets before queue lock and targets never change afterward.
entries.cutover_gate: All locked actions carry validated target IDs and resolution creates no target prompt.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete resolution-time target selection and target mutation.

entries.v06_rule: Current execution paths do not enforce the V0.7 all-action lock-time reservation contract.
entries.v07_rule: A player queue locks only after complete per-action reservations for every action are created atomically.
entries.cutover_gate: Atomic lock, exact consume/release, privacy, and cold restore pass for every action.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete execution-time affordability fallbacks and unreserved queue paths.

entries.v06_rule: Realtime systems may continue around card windows under V0.6 timing owners.
entries.v07_rule: World simulation continues during submission but pauses through sequential card resolution with no inter-card tick.
entries.cutover_gate: Clock-domain tests prove active submission and zero world/RNG delta throughout resolution.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete card-resolution paths that advance normal world ticks.

entries.v06_rule: An existing end condition, including Victory audit or last solvent player, can settle without a lead macro-round boundary.
entries.v07_rule: Every original end trigger becomes pending and settles only after batch, refresh, maintenance, complete macro round, and boundary revalidation.
entries.cutover_gate: Pending, failed revalidation, successful exact-once settlement, and restore vectors all pass.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete every direct audit-to-settlement path that bypasses the attested macro-round boundary.

entries.v06_rule: Region popup is the ordinary-card browse and purchase entry point.
entries.v07_rule: Region popup shows region facts but normal-card acquisition occurs only on the unified track.
entries.cutover_gate: Player and AI ordinary-card intents originate from the unified track semantic source only.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete region-popup purchase controls and action routes.

entries.v06_rule: Current hand flow is not governed by the V0.7 no-refill batch boundary.
entries.v07_rule: No draw or reshuffle occurs during submission or resolution; maintenance pauses world time, draws to five, offers optional merges, and auto-ends without another merge at its timeout.
entries.cutover_gate: Batch vectors prove stable hand size during lock/resolution and deterministic draw-to-five after each maintenance merge.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete draw or reshuffle hooks reachable during submission and resolution.

entries.v06_rule: The current runtime has no complete precommitted public-direction and hidden-weight market color cycle.
entries.v07_rule: Players precommit distinct UP/DOWN colors; the last legal selection auto-locks; actor-linked directions reveal together while lead identity, effective weight, and raw contributions stay secret.
entries.cutover_gate: 3/4/6/8-player deterministic vectors prove precommit, reveal, normalization, and viewer privacy with no empty phase.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete competing market-cycle writers and any public lead-weight decomposition.

entries.v06_rule: The current runtime does not use the frozen hidden lead order and exact alternating reverse macro rounds.
entries.v07_rule: One hidden session order drives each player leading once per macro round; each following round reverses exactly, and a boundary weights the entry lead before advancing its cursor.
entries.cutover_gate: Seeded 3-8-player replay proves fixed order, exact reverse, frozen roster, and self-only lead notice.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete independent lead selection, public lead identity, and reshuffle-per-cycle paths.

entries.v06_rule: V0.6 Save sections describe only the current runtime owners.
entries.v07_rule: V0.7 uses a new versioned schema; V0.6 Save cannot directly resume as V0.7 and must be backed up before migration.
entries.cutover_gate: Version gate, backup workflow, complete V0.7 round trip, cold restore, and deterministic continuation are proven.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete any unversioned path that interprets a V0.6 envelope as V0.7 state.

entries.v06_rule: Current RNG ownership does not contain all seven V0.7 deck, track, and hidden-order streams.
entries.v07_rule: Starter shuffle, per-player reshuffle, track type/color/normal/commodity draws, and initial hidden order use separated saved replay streams.
entries.cutover_gate: Each stream replays independently and AI observation, UI, hover, drag, and animation produce zero draw delta.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete shared or presentation-triggered draw points after lineage migration.

entries.v06_rule: V0.6 organization effects can raise a player's ordinary hand capacity above five.
entries.v07_rule: Normal hand capacity is constitutionally fixed at five and cannot be increased by role, organization, card, or effect.
entries.cutover_gate: Core, AI, player projection, and Save all expose exactly five normal-hand slots for every player.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete hand-capacity modifiers, aliases, UI expansion, and stale organization or fixture expectations.

entries.v06_rule: V0.6 organization effects can raise a player's submitted card or action count above the base limit.
entries.v07_rule: All active action kinds share a constitutional maximum of five actions per player per batch with no capacity modifier.
entries.cutover_gate: Every human and AI queue rejects a sixth active action regardless of source or legacy modifier.
entries.legacy_deletion_gate: Delete submission-capacity modifiers, expanded slot UI, and stale organization or fixture expectations.
